The PIN can\'t be recovered, because your login is encrypted with it. FrigateCtrl will log out and forget the server, the app lock and anything kept from the server. Your Frigate server isn\'t changed.
At least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN. If you forget it, the only way back in is to log out and log in again.
PINs now need at least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN. Your login is encrypted with it while the app is locked.
Ask for an app PIN (and optionally your fingerprint) when opening FrigateCtrl. While locked, your login stays encrypted with the PIN, and no camera is shown or streamed.
FrigateCtrl has no analytics or tracking. It only talks to your own Frigate server.
